title: Coach
subtitle: Patterns from how you actually use Claude Code, and what to do about them.

empty.title: Nothing to flag right now
empty.description: The Coach is watching your sessions in the background. When something's worth your attention, it'll show up here.

playbook.noteStrong: The playbook defines what the Coach watches for.
playbook.note: A practice you turn off here is simply never evaluated — it won't appear in the Feed, and nothing runs in the background for it.
playbook.previewLabel: Preview — what this produces in the Feed
playbook.settingsDescription: A warning never closes on its own while its session is still active. Once the session ends, this is how long to wait before its open warnings close automatically — so you don't have to dismiss every one by hand. One window for every practice — nothing to configure per practice.
playbook.settingsParseError: Enter a number of minutes, 0 or greater
playbook.settingsDisabledHint: 0 disables this — a warning only closes when you dismiss it, even after its session ends.

sessionTokenCeiling.name: Session Token Ceiling
sessionTokenCeiling.description: Flags when a single session's total token usage crosses a ceiling, before quality degrades or the context window becomes unreliable.
sessionTokenCeiling.message: Session context is becoming large ({{tokens}} tokens)
sessionTokenCeiling.recommendation: Compact or clear the session before continuing — copy your current context first.
sessionTokenCeiling.autoResolveOnSessionEndLabel: Resolve automatically after the session ends
sessionTokenCeiling.autoResolveOnSessionEndHint: A session that's no longer active can't be compacted or cleared. Once it ends, this warning closes on its own after the Auto-resolve window above — never while the session is still active.

accountWeeklyBalance.name: Account Rotation
accountWeeklyBalance.description: Flags when the Claude account you're actively using has crossed the Usage page's Rotation Plan switch threshold and another connected account still has headroom to take over.
accountWeeklyBalance.thresholdInfo: Uses the same {{value}}% switch threshold as the Usage page's Rotation Plan — edit it there, not here.
accountWeeklyBalance.autoResolveNote: Clears itself automatically once the active account drops back under the threshold (a weekly reset, or once you've actually switched) — nothing to configure.
accountWeeklyBalance.message: {{activeLabel}} is at {{activePct}}% of its weekly quota — switch to {{lowLabel}} ({{lowPct}}% used) before it runs out.
accountWeeklyBalance.recommendation: Switch your active work to {{lowLabel}} — the Usage page's Rotation Plan already recommends it, and it protects {{activeLabel}}'s remaining weekly quota.
